# codex-go: Go SDK for the Codex app-server JSON-RPC protocol
# Version: v0.2.0 | Aligned to codex commit 14c8b7771ab2 | Protocol schema: v2 (stable scope) | Module: github.com/zealbase/codex-app-server-go | Go 1.25+

## Install
go get github.com/zealbase/codex-app-server-go

## Client creation
client, err := codexgo.New(opts...)
# Transport opts (pick one):
#   WithStdioTransport(stdin, stdout)      -- local binary via stdin/stdout
#   WithStdioProcess(binaryPath, args...)  -- spawn the codex binary
#   WithWSTransport(dialCtx, url)          -- WebSocket (recommended for remote)
#   WithReconnectingWSTransport(ctx, url)  -- WebSocket with transparent socket re-dial
#   WithUnixSocketWSTransport(ctx, socket) -- WebSocket over a unix socket
#   WithHTTPTransport(baseURL)             -- WIP: HTTP+SSE; needs ws-http-bridge sidecar (else 405)
#   WithReconnectingHTTPTransport(baseURL) -- WIP: same bridge requirement
#   WithTransport(t)                       -- bring your own Transport
#   WithRetry(cfg)                         -- wrap current transport with retry
# Auth opts: WithHTTPBearerToken(token), WithWSBearerToken(token),
#            WithHTTPAPIKey(key), WithWSAPIKey(key), WithAutoLogin(apiKey)
# Handler opts: WithApprovalHandler(h), WithRequestHandler(h)
# Reliability opts: WithAutoReconnect(), WithSessionBackfill(limit),
#                   WithEventSubscriberTimeout(d)
# Concurrency opts: WithMaxThreads(n)  -- -1=unlimited, 0=default(64)
# Handshake opts: WithClientInfo(name, title, version), WithInitializeCapabilities(*InitializeCapabilities)
# Process opts: WithProcessDir(dir), WithProcessEnv(key, value)

## High-level session API (recommended)
thread, err := client.StartThread(ctx, opts...)   // returns *SessionThread
thread, err := client.ResumeThread(ctx, id, opts...)
thread.Close()  // release semaphore slot

# ThreadOption helpers:
#   WithThreadModel(model), WithThreadApprovalPolicy(AskForApproval),
#   WithThreadApprovalsReviewer(ApprovalsReviewer), WithThreadCWD(cwd),
#   WithThreadEphemeral(bool), WithThreadPersonality(p), WithInitialInput(input)
#   WithThreadModelProvider(id)   -- select a configured model provider by id
#   WithThreadConfigOverride(key, value) -- per-thread config overlay; e.g.
#     WithThreadConfigOverride("model_providers.acme", map[string]any{
#         "name":"acme","base_url":"https://.../v1","wire_api":"responses",
#         "experimental_bearer_token":"..."})
#     The app-server deep-merges it for this thread only, so a shared server can
#     serve callers that each bring their own provider without editing server config.

result, err := thread.Run(ctx, "prompt", opts...)     // synchronous turn, string input
result, err := thread.RunInputs(ctx, []UserInput{...}, opts...)   // structured input
# TurnOption: WithModel, WithApprovalPolicy(AskForApproval), WithApprovalsReviewer(ApprovalsReviewer),
#   WithSandboxPolicy(SandboxPolicy), WithSandboxMode(SandboxMode), WithCWD, WithEffort,
#   WithOutputSchema(schema), WithInputs(...UserInput)

result.FinalAgentText() string  -- last agent-message text (searches Items, Turn.Items, DeltaText)
result.Turn.Status              -- "completed" | "interrupted" | "failed"
result.Usage                    -- *ThreadTokenUsage; nil unless thread/tokenUsage/updated arrived
result.Items                    -- []Item captured via streaming events
result.DeltaText                -- streaming delta fallback text

events, err := thread.RunStreamed(ctx, "prompt")  // streaming; drain or cancel ctx

## Input builders (turn/steer payloads are []UserInput upstream, not a bare string)
TextInput(text) UserInput
TextInputs(text) []UserInput
ImageInput(url) UserInput
LocalImageInput(path) (UserInput, error)

## Sandbox / approval builders
SandboxPolicyFromMode(SandboxMode) *SandboxPolicy   // mode spellings -> tagged policy object
ApprovalUntrusted() / ApprovalOnRequest() / ApprovalNever() / ApprovalGranular(g)  // AskForApproval

## Event subscription
sub := client.Events()
defer sub.Close()
for event := range sub.C() {
    switch v := event.Value.(type) {
    case codexgo.ItemAgentMessageDeltaEvent: // v.Text
    case codexgo.TurnCompletedEvent:         // v.TurnID, v.Status, v.Turn  (no Usage: see below)
    case codexgo.ItemCompletedEvent:         // v.Item
    }
}
// Delivery contract: publish never blocks a producer; a slow subscriber is bounded
// (terminal via Err()/Done(), never a silent drop). Always handle termination:
// for { select { case ev, ok := <-sub.C(): ... ; case <-sub.Done(): return } }

## Key types
Thread{ID, Name, Status ThreadStatus, Turns []Turn}
Turn{ID, Items []Item, ItemsView TurnItemsView, Status TurnStatus, StartedAt, CompletedAt}   // no Usage: see thread/tokenUsage/updated
Item{ID, Kind ItemKind, Payload json.RawMessage}
TurnResult{Turn, Items []Item, Usage *ThreadTokenUsage, Error *TurnError, DeltaText string}
ThreadTokenUsage{Last, Total TokenUsageBreakdown; ModelContextWindow int64}
ThreadTokenUsage arrives ONLY via the thread/tokenUsage/updated notification; turn/completed
sends {threadId, turn} and carries no usage (upstream behavior).

## Enums (wire values in quotes)
ThreadStatus: "notLoaded" | "idle" | "active" | "systemError"
TurnStatus: "inProgress" | "completed" | "interrupted" | "failed"
TurnItemsView: "notLoaded" | "summary" | "full"
AskForApproval: "untrusted" | "on-request" | "never" | {"granular": {...}}
ApprovalsReviewer: "user" | "auto_review" | "guardian_subagent"
SandboxPolicy (tagged object): {"type":"readOnly"} | {"type":"workspaceWrite"} | {"type":"dangerFullAccess"} | {"type":"externalSandbox"}
SandboxMode (mode spellings, converted by SandboxPolicyFromMode): "read-only" | "workspace-write" | "full-auto"
ItemKind: userMessage | agentMessage | plan | reasoning | commandExecution | fileChange |
  mcpToolCall | dynamicToolCall | collabAgentToolCall | subAgentActivity | webSearch |
  imageView | imageGeneration | sleep | enteredReviewMode | exitedReviewMode |
  contextCompaction | hookPrompt

## ApprovalHandler interface
HandleCommandExecutionApproval(ctx, CommandExecutionApprovalRequest) (CommandExecutionApprovalResult, error)
HandleFileChangeApproval(ctx, FileChangeApprovalRequest) (FileChangeApprovalResult, error)
HandlePermissionsApproval(ctx, PermissionsApprovalRequest) (PermissionsApprovalResult, error)
HandleUserInputRequest(ctx, UserInputRequest) (UserInputResult, error)
# Decision values: accept | acceptForSession | decline | cancel (+ exec/network policy amendments)
# ApprovalHandler timeouts are refused by default (never granted); see Dispatcher.ApprovalTimeout.

## Server-push notification types (62 of 63 declared-stable notifications are typed)
TurnStartedEvent, TurnCompletedEvent, ItemStartedEvent, ItemCompletedEvent,
TurnDiffUpdatedEvent, TurnPlanUpdatedEvent, ThreadTokenUsageUpdatedEvent,
ThreadStartedEvent, ThreadArchivedEvent, ThreadUnarchivedEvent, ThreadClosedEvent,
ThreadStatusChangedEvent, ThreadGoalUpdatedEvent, ThreadGoalClearedEvent,
ServerRequestResolvedEvent, ErrorEvent,
ItemAgentMessageDeltaEvent{Text}, ItemPlanDeltaEvent{Text},
ItemReasoningSummaryTextDeltaEvent{Text}, ItemReasoningTextDeltaEvent{Text},
ItemCommandExecutionOutputDeltaEvent{Delta}, ItemFileChangePatchUpdatedEvent,
ItemAutoApprovalReviewStartedEvent, ItemAutoApprovalReviewCompletedEvent
# Extra notifications (events_extra.go):
ThreadDeletedEvent, ThreadNameUpdatedEvent, ThreadCompactedEvent, ThreadSettingsUpdatedEvent,
AccountUpdatedEvent, AccountRateLimitsUpdatedEvent, WarningEvent, ConfigWarningEvent,
DeprecationNoticeEvent, GuardianWarningEvent, WindowsWorldWritableWarningEvent,
WindowsSandboxSetupCompletedEvent, ModelReroutedEvent, ModelVerificationEvent,
TurnModerationMetadataEvent, ProcessExitedEvent, ProcessOutputDeltaEvent,
TerminalInteractionEvent, McpToolCallProgressEvent, HookStartedEvent, HookCompletedEvent,
RawResponseItemCompletedEvent, McpServerStatusUpdatedEvent, McpServerOauthLoginCompletedEvent,
SkillsChangedEvent, FsChangedEvent, AppListUpdatedEvent, RemoteControlStatusChangedEvent,
ExternalAgentConfigImportCompletedEvent, ExternalAgentConfigImportProgressEvent,
ThreadRealtime{Started,Closed,Error,ItemAdded,Sdp,OutputAudioDelta,TranscriptDelta,TranscriptDone}Event
# Unknown methods -> RawNotificationEvent
# Synthetic SDK events (not on the wire) use an sdk/ prefix:
#   sdk/sessionBackfilled, sdk/reconnectStarted, sdk/reconnectSucceeded, sdk/reconnectFailed,
#   sdk/sessionRecovered, sdk/unhandledServerRequest, sdk/pendingApprovalLost

## Reliability
# A transport reconnect restores the socket, not the session. With AutoReconnect enabled the SDK
# re-runs initialize+initialized and re-subscribes every tracked thread via thread/resume, then
# backfills history (thread/turns/list, default 20 turns via WithSessionBackfill).
# Contract is at-least-once + application idempotency; upstream has no client event replay.
